Written to a separate file (constitutional-bodies-r2.json) per this segment's own brief rather than overwriting round 1, since both were produced by independent agents; a later merge step should reconcile them (they largely agree — see per-entity/position notes for the specific deltas r2 found). WebSearch was unavailable for this whole session (shared 200/200 budget already exhausted before this segment started, confirmed by the error: 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)') — all r2 research used curl (desktop Chrome UA) against Wikipedia's parse API, official portals (fincomindia.nic.in, cag.gov.in, gstcouncil.gov.in), and WebFetch, plus pypdf against the Sixteenth Finance Commission's own report PDF. eci.gov.in and ncbc.nic.in-style Deputy-EC/Deputy-CAG rosters are JS-rendered SPAs curl cannot read, and browser tools are disallowed for this segment per SCHEMA.md, so Deputy ECs, Deputy CAGs, and the Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities' current holder remain unresolved (confidence: low, holder: null) rather than invented, matching round 1's approach for those same gaps. New/upgraded in r2 versus round 1: full 9-member UPSC roster with exact term-start/end dates (round 1 had only the Chairperson); UPSC sanctioned strength corrected from 11 to 10; CAG since-date (2024-11-21); NCBC Chairperson since-date (2026-03-18) plus 3 named Members and a confirmed-vacant Vice-Chairman seat (round 1 had the Chairperson only, at low confidence); the 16th Finance Commission's actual vertical-devolution recommendation — retaining the States' 41% share unchanged from FC-15 — sourced to Chapter 7 para 7.68 of the Commission's own report PDF (round 1 had explicitly left this blank); confirmation the 16th FC report was tabled in Parliament with no exact day found; an explicit checked-and-not-found result for whether a 17th FC has been constituted (it has not, so far as any source here shows); and the most recent confirmed GST Council meeting (56th, 3-4 September 2025, New Delhi) from the Council's own site.

entities.name: Election Commission of India
entities.description: Conducts and supervises elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, state legislatures, and the offices of President and Vice-President; a permanent multi-member constitutional body.
entities.legalBasis: Article 324 of the Constitution; Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023
entities.hq: Nirvachan Sadan, Ashoka Road, New Delhi

entities.name: Chief Electoral Officers of States and UTs (aggregate)
entities.description: One Chief Electoral Officer per state/UT, appointed/designated under Section 13A of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, to supervise elections in that state/UT under the ECI's superintendence, direction and control.
entities.legalBasis: Representation of the People Act, 1950, Section 13A

entities.name: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
entities.description: Audits all receipts and expenditure of the Union and state governments, government-owned bodies and corporations, reporting to Parliament and state legislatures; is the head of the Indian Audit and Accounts Department (IA&AD).
entities.legalBasis: Article 148 of the Constitution; Comptroller and Auditor General's (Duties, Powers and Conditions of Service) Act, 1971

entities.name: Indian Audit and Accounts Department
entities.description: The professional cadre and field offices (headed by officers of the Indian Audit and Accounts Service) through which the CAG conducts audits of Union, state and local-body accounts across India.
entities.legalBasis: Article 148 read with the CAG's (DPC) Act, 1971

entities.name: Union Public Service Commission
entities.description: Conducts recruitment examinations (Civil Services Examination etc.) and advises the Union government on recruitment rules and service/disciplinary matters for the All India Services and Central Civil Services.
entities.hq: Dholpur House, Shahjahan Road, New Delhi
entities.notes: r2 correction: sanctioned strength is 10 (incl. Chairperson), not 11 as recorded in the round-1 pass — the current Wikipedia members table states 'nine members, including the chairperson, compared to its sanctioned strength of ten members.'

entities.name: Sixteenth Finance Commission
entities.description: Recommended how the Union divides net tax proceeds between itself and the states (vertical devolution) and among the states (horizontal devolution), and the principles for grants-in-aid and local-body/disaster grants, for the five-year award period 2026-27 to 2030-31.
entities.legalBasis: Article 280 of the Constitution; Finance Commission (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1951
entities.hq: Jawahar Vyapar Bhawan, Tolstoy Marg, New Delhi
entities.notes: r2 findings from the official Report of the Sixteenth Finance Commission (Vol I - Main Report, 'Report for 2026-31'; PDF last-modified 2026-02-01 per fincomindia.nic.in server headers; the council's own homepage confirms 'Sixteenth Finance Commission Report tabled in Parliament'; the exact day of submission to the President / tabling in Parliament was not found in machine-readable text on the site and is NOT invented here — treat 'tabled ~Feb 2026' as month-level confidence only). Award period: 2026-27 to 2030-31 (fiscal), confirmed. Vertical devolution recommendation: Chapter 7, para 7.68 of the report states verbatim: 'Presently, for its award period, the Commission recommends retaining the States' share in the divisible pool at its current level of 41 per cent' — i.e. NO change from the Fifteenth Finance Commission's 41%. Seventeenth Finance Commission: no evidence found that it has been constituted as of 2026-09-25 — en.wikipedia.org has no 'Seventeenth Finance Commission' page (checked directly, API returns 'missing'), and fincomindia.nic.in's homepage makes no mention of a 17th FC. The Sixteenth Finance Commission Wikipedia infobox does list a 'Superseding Commission: Seventeenth Finance Commission' field, but this reads as an infobox-template placeholder for 'whichever FC comes next in sequence', not sourced evidence of actual constitution — do not treat as confirmed.

entities.name: National Commission for Scheduled Castes
entities.description: Investigates and monitors safeguards for Scheduled Castes, inquires into specific complaints of rights violations, and advises the Union and state governments on SC welfare and development.
entities.notes: Statutory sanctioned strength under Article 338 is a Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and 3 other Members (5 total); as of the source checked only a Chairperson and 2 Members are recorded — Vice-Chairperson and one Member seat are unconfirmed/likely vacant. Do not invent names for the unconfirmed seats.

entities.name: National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
entities.description: Investigates and monitors safeguards for Scheduled Tribes, inquires into specific complaints of rights violations, and advises the Union and state governments on ST welfare and development.
entities.notes: Statutory sanctioned strength under Article 338A is a Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson and 3 other Members (5 total); as of the source checked, Vice-Chairperson seat is unconfirmed/likely vacant.

entities.name: National Commission for Backward Classes
entities.description: Examines requests for inclusion in/exclusion from the OBC central list and advises the Union government on the welfare and development of socially and educationally backward classes.
entities.legalBasis: Article 338B of the Constitution (constitutional status since the 102nd Amendment, 2018); originally a statutory body under the National Commission for Backward Classes Act, 1993.
entities.notes: Constitutional status granted 2018-08-11 via the 102nd Amendment. r2 upgrade: current members table (dated citation [8] on the Wikipedia article) now confirmed with a chairperson succession history, resolving round-1's low-confidence flag.

entities.name: Goods and Services Tax Council
entities.description: Joint forum of the Union and state finance ministers that recommends GST rates, exemptions, thresholds and administrative rules; decisions require a weighted majority (Union 1/3, states 2/3 of votes cast).
entities.legalBasis: Article 279A of the Constitution (inserted by the 101st Amendment, 2016)
entities.notes: Chairperson is the Union Finance Minister ex officio (position in-pos-minister-finance, owned by segment council-of-ministers — referenced, not redefined here). Members are the Union Minister of State for Finance and the Finance/other nominated Minister of every state and UT-with-legislature, ex officio; not individually enumerated here. r2: most recent Council meeting confirmed via the Council's own homepage 'What's New' listing is the 56th GST Council meeting, held 3-4 September 2025 in New Delhi (notice for the meeting explicitly dated); a 55th meeting is also referenced as prior. No meeting later than the 56th was found on the official site as of 2026-09-25 — this may mean the site's front page is not fully current rather than that no later meeting occurred; flagged, not asserted either way.

entities.name: GST Council Secretariat
entities.description: Standing secretariat that services the GST Council, staffed by officers from Union and state governments; headed by a Secretary who is also ex officio the Revenue Secretary.
entities.notes: Head-of-secretariat is ex officio the Secretary, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance — that position record is owned by the ministries-finance segment, not redefined here to avoid a duplicate/conflicting holder record.

entities.name: Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities (Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities)
entities.description: A single-officer constitutional post that investigates matters relating to constitutional safeguards for linguistic minorities and reports to the President, who lays the report before Parliament and forwards it to the states concerned.
entities.notes: Office sits administratively under the Ministry of Minority Affairs. r2: could not confirm a current named incumbent via Wikipedia (no dedicated article exists) or via eci/minorityaffairs sources reachable by curl/WebFetch in this pass — the ministry's own site and a dedicated Commissioner-for-Linguistic-Minorities page were not reachable/found. Left unresolved rather than invented, same as round 1.

entities.name: National Commission for Linguistic Minorities (proposed)
entities.description: A statutory National Commission for Linguistic Minorities (to replace/supplement the single Special Officer above) was recommended by the Sachar Committee (2006) and has been proposed in Parliament at various points; it has not been constituted as an operating body as of the source checked.
entities.legalBasis: Proposed; no dedicated constitutional or statutory instrument currently in force
entities.notes: Included per brief's canonical-ID list; NOT a currently operating body — do not treat as staffed. r2: re-checked, still found no evidence this has been constituted as of 2026-09-25.
